glossZh: 包括，把…包括在内；把…算入
glossEn: have as a part, be made up out of / consider as part of something
note: have as a part / consider as part of something / add as part of a set。**关键：include 只表示「是其中一部分」，不表示「在空间上围住」** —— 后者是 enclose。这是 include 最常见的误解。线索：The price includes breakfast. / include sb in the team.
